newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Int'l Airline raises fares.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Int'l Airline raises fares.

text.p: Pakistan International Airline (PIA) has increased fares on foreign travel by 10 to 15 percent, a spokesman for PIA said on Wednesday.

He said all normal fares, including business and first class, to destinations in North America, Europe and the Far East would go up 10 percent. Excursion fares would rise 15 percent. Fares of all classes to Middle East destinations would increase 15 percent.
The spokesman said the increases would be applied from December 16.
